Q: What is lambda-GRPO? A: One-line fix to GRPO training: adds step-based credit assignment. 12% gain on reasoning tasks. Paper arxiv:2509.21154. Replace standard GRPO loss function.

Q: What is DPOP training? A: Better than DPO/SimPO: adds gated penalty when policy assigns lower likelihood to preferred vs rejected responses. 5.3% gain over DPO on AlpacaEval 2. Paper arxiv:2606.12505.

Q: What is DeepSeek-V4-Flash? A: 284B params, 13B active MoE. CSA+HCA hybrid attention. 27% inference FLOPs of V3.2 at 1M context. Fits 2x A40 with quantization. Paper arxiv:2606.19348.

Q: What is BiPRM? A: Bidirectional Process Reward Model. Right-to-left eval alongside left-to-right. Only 0.3% parameter increase, 5% latency, 10.6% average gain. Paper arxiv:2508.01682.

Q: What is LADDER algorithm? A: Recursive self-improvement through difficulty gradients. LLMs self-improve by generating progressively simpler variants. Llama 3B: 1% to 82% accuracy. 7B outperforms GPT-4o. Paper arxiv:2503.

Q: What is TransMamba? A: Sequence-level hybrid Transformer-Mamba. Dynamically switches between attention and SSM at different token lengths. Memory Converter bridges both paradigms. Paper arxiv:2503.24067.

Q: What is COCONUT latent reasoning? A: Chain of Continuous Thought. Uses last hidden state directly as continuous thought. Enables breadth-first search reasoning. Paper arxiv:2412.06769.
